programmes.d: A house has been busted as a marijuana-growing operation and now needs massive repairs.
An elderly woman needs to renovate her bathroom to make it more accessible.
Todd and Duane, excited about buying their first house together, tackle their home inspector's suggestions with enthusiasm until then they discover something that could ruin everything.

Mike and crew make an emergency house call to Fred and Sara's diminutive, historical two-storey; gaping holes in their seemingly solid home inspection have led to a high-stakes repair mission for Damon and the construction team.

Returning to Fred and Sara's petite historical home, where inspection misses have launched a rescue mission; Damon and the crew are tested by leaks, mold, foundation holes, dangerous fireplaces, shocking electrical and a plumbing disaster.
Mike and MJ add a partial second story to the country house; dangerous structural issues in the river house force them to take down the roof and second floor walls.

Facing major structural and water issues at the river house, Mike and MJ decide to take the whole house down so they can rebuild it; at the country house, they notice water on the basement floor during a mechanical walk-through.
Problems with a contractor halt the addition of a much-needed second floor.
Lisa and Joe decide to have an existing wooden retaining wall in their backyard rebuilt using concrete blocks.
